title: Custom Color Palette policies
description: Settings a Workspace admin can push to staff. See docs/DEPLOY.md for the Admin console runbook.

palette.title: Organization brand palette
palette.description: Default brand colors for everyone in the organization. Each user can still personalize their own palette; this is the default they start from.

name.title: Color name
name.description: Shown on the swatch tooltip, e.g. Poppy.

palettes.title: Organization brand palettes
palettes.description: Several named palettes for the organization, when one is not enough (sub-brands, product lines). Staff start on the first. Takes precedence over the single 'palette' setting, which stays supported so existing deployments keep working.

name.title: Palette name
name.description: Shown when choosing between palettes, e.g. Retail or Wholesale.

swatches.title: Colors in this palette
swatches.description: The brand colors, same shape as the single 'palette' setting.

name.title: Color name
name.description: Shown on the swatch tooltip, e.g. Poppy.

paletteLocked.title: Enforce the organization palette
paletteLocked.description: When true, staff see the organization palette and cannot change it. Leave unset (or false) to let each person personalize their own colors, which is the default behavior. Has no effect unless a palette is also set.
